title: Plex Rebuffering Sessions by Client
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player and achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tautulli:play
| stats sum(buffer_count) as buffers, count as sessions by player
| where buffers>0
| sort - buffers
description: Ranks playback clients by how often they buffer so you can tell whether the problem lives in the server, the Wi-Fi, or one fussy TV app.
value: Streaming quality complaints are hard to troubleshoot from memory; a client-based buffer leaderboard turns them into evidence.
implementation: Forward Tautulli playback metrics with buffer counts; review weekly and optimize the worst client or location first.
visualization: Table of playback clients by buffers and session count.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which TV, tablet, or streaming box keeps getting the most annoying playback buffering.
